name: Sunlord-gz
title: GZ series multilayer chip ferrite beads, 0201 to 1206
summary: A family of two-terminal multilayer ferrite chip beads for EMI suppression on signal lines, built with silver inner conductors in a magnetically shielded body. It comes in five chip sizes from 0603 metric (0201) to 3216 metric (1206) and three ferrite materials, D, E and U, with impedances at 100 MHz from under 15 Ω up to 2500 Ω and rated currents from 50 mA to 2.2 A.

operation.text: EMI noise suppression on low-speed signal lines in equipment such as computers and their peripherals, camcorders, LCD televisions, telecom and office equipment, over a band from some tens to some hundreds of MHz.
Silver conductor layers sit inside a magnetically shielded ferrite body, which keeps crosstalk low.
Three ferrite materials, coded D, E and U, together with the range of impedance values, cover different applications.
Parts with a rated current above 1000 mA carry their full rating up to +85 °C. From +85 °C to +125 °C their allowed current falls in a straight line to 1 A.
